Play Five Nights At Frickbears 3 in your browser on YukiOS - A fan-made parody inspired by Scott Cawthon's Five Nights at Freddy's series. Players sit in a security office, monitor cameras, and survive five nights against haunted animatronics that grow more aggressive as the hours pass.

Play Inscryption in your browser on YukiOS - Inscryption is a 2021 deck-building roguelike by Daniel Mullins Games. It blends card battles, escape-room puzzles, and psychological horror across multiple shifting genres, becoming widely praised for its meta narrative and twist-filled story.

Play Night In The Woods in your browser on YukiOS - Night in the Woods is a 2017 narrative adventure by Infinite Fall, following Mae Borowski, a college dropout who returns to her dying mining town. Play Who's Your Daddy in your browser on YukiOS - Who's Your Daddy is a 2015 multiplayer comedy game by Joe Williams. One player controls a clueless father trying to babyproof the house while another plays a baby attempting to harm itself in absurd and creative ways.

Play Suicide Guy in your browser on YukiOS - Suicide Guy is a 2017 first-person puzzle-platformer by Chubby Pixel. Players take the role of a man trapped inside his dreams who must die in increasingly ridiculous ways in order to wake up and save his beer.

Play Youtubers Life Omg in your browser on YukiOS - Youtubers Life OMG! is a 2016 simulation game by U-Play Online. Players create a YouTube channel from scratch, recording videos, gaining subscribers, and managing their growing fame and personal life.
